title: Field repository
summary: Keeps the TableTools field registry in one SQLite file per database, filled from Firebird (read-only), with a diffable text backup
intro: Read this when you want the TableTools field repository without Firebird tables or the TableTools IDE package. Run drag-lint repo init, then repo import-fb (Micronite) or repo seed-fb (any Firebird database), keep the text backup in version control with repo backup, and point several projects at one repository with the fieldRepository key. Firebird is never modified.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Field Repository > Open Field Repository Editor...
steps: Open a project that has a field repository (fieldRepository key or the default file)
Choose drag-lint > Field Repository > Open Field Repository Editor...
The grid editor dl-field-repo.exe opens on that repository

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Field Repository > Refresh Schema from Database...
steps: Open a project with a field repository
Choose drag-lint > Field Repository > Refresh Schema from Database...
Enter the Firebird connection string; the output of drag-lint repo refresh-schema is shown

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Field Repository > FDMemTable from CSV...
steps: Choose drag-lint > Field Repository > FDMemTable from CSV...
Pick a field-definition CSV
The Pascal source is written next to the CSV as `<name>.memtable.pas`

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Field Repository > Generate / Update ORM Source...
steps: Open the project whose field repository describes the tables
Choose drag-lint > Field Repository > Generate / Update ORM Source...
Pick the folder of the `i<T>`/`u<T>` units; give table names for NEW units, or leave it empty to update the DB-RAD regions of every existing unit (optionally also the _SERVER/_CLIENT folders)
Read the dry-run summary and answer Yes to write (repo gen-orm / update-orm --apply)

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Field Repository > Generate DataService Units...
steps: Choose drag-lint > Field Repository > Generate DataService Units...
Give the table names, then pick the _SERVER and _CLIENT folders
Read the dry-run summary and answer Yes to write (repo gen-dataservice --apply); add the listed units to the projects

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Field Repository > Param Array Assistant...
steps: Open and save the form unit
Choose drag-lint > Field Repository > Param Array Assistant...
Answer whether to prepare the queries first (--prepare-queries)
Read the --plan summary and answer Yes to write through the compile gate (repo gen-param-array --apply)

surfaces.usage: drag-lint repo <init|info|import-fb|seed-fb|refresh-schema|backup|restore|gen-memtable|gen-param-array|gen-orm|update-orm|gen-dataservice> (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--connection "<Firebird connection string>"] [--in <file>] [--output <file>] [--name <Name>] [--replace] [--dry-run] [--json]   (the field repository: one SQLite file per database; Firebird is only read; gen-param-array needs no repository)
help: drag-lint repo init           (--repo <file> | --project <project file>)   (create an empty field repository; exit 1 when the file exists)
drag-lint repo info           (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--json|--format json]   (path, schema version, rows per table, DL_META keys; exit 1 when not a repository)

drag-lint repo import-fb      --connection "<Firebird connection string>" (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--replace]   (copy the FIB$ registry tables; read-only on Firebird; --replace writes a before-import text backup first; exit 1 failure, 2 schema drift)

drag-lint repo seed-fb        --connection "<Firebird connection string>" (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--dry-run]   (fill an EMPTY repository from the Firebird schema; read-only on Firebird)

drag-lint repo refresh-schema --connection "<Firebird connection string>" (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--dry-run]   (re-read the Firebird schema into a filled repository, keep hand-edited columns, mark vanished columns; --dry-run prints the diff only)
drag-lint repo backup         (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--output <file>]   (write the diffable text backup; default <repo>.txt)

drag-lint repo restore        --in <backup file> (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--replace]   (create the repository when missing; a malformed backup prints "line <n>: ..." and exits 2, nothing changed)
drag-lint repo gen-memtable   --in <csv file> [--name <Name>] [--output <file>]   (Pascal source that builds the fields of a TFDMemTable from a field-definition CSV; exit 2 on a bad CSV)

drag-lint repo gen-param-array (--in [--dfm ] | --project --all [--only ]) [--query ] [--table ] [--step-size ] [--progress-form
] [--prepare-queries] [--plan | --apply --project [--no-backup] [--platform

] [--rsvars ] [--build-timeout ]] [--json] (FireDAC Array-DML loop from the unit's DFM, inserted as a braced comment before the final end.; no flag prints the block, --plan the diff, --apply writes through ONE compile gate; --prepare-queries first does the IDE assistant's query preparation (each SELECT TFDQuery gets its TFDUpdateSQL INSERT SQL, ObjectView=False, no CachedUpdates; update object / schema adapter renamed ZZZ*, persistent fields removed with their declarations; .dfm + .pas diffs in --plan, both written through the gate); exit 1 a unit refused or no block, 2 bad flags or a baseline that does not build)

drag-lint repo gen-orm        (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) --code-dir <folder> [--table <T,...>] [--apply [--no-backup]]   (new i<T>.PAS + u<T>.PAS ORM units per repository table; dry run prints the diff, --apply writes 7-bit ASCII, an existing file is first copied to <file>.BCKn; prints add to project: per new file)

drag-lint repo update-orm     (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) --code-dir <folder> [--server-dir <folder>] [--client-dir <folder>] [--table <T,...>] [--save-form legacy|current] [--apply [--no-backup]]   (rewrites ONLY the DB-RAD regions of the existing i/u/_SERVER/_CLIENT units, every other byte kept; --save-form legacy (default) = the FIELD_AS_TYPE parameter binding the ORM3 units carry, current = TableTools 2026-05-19 .Value / .AsWideMemo / Set1Byte / NULL-timestamp Clear)

drag-lint repo gen-dataservice (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) --server-dir <folder> --client-dir <folder> [--table <T,...>] [--save-form legacy|current] [--apply [--no-backup]]   (new u<T>_SERVER.PAS + u<T>_CLIENT.PAS per table and the two DI container units; prints add to project: per new file)
